stor.T_assumed_C.source: Owner decision 2026-11-13 (decisions/2026-11-13-storage-data.md): 20 degC GUESS for provisional storage/booster calculations; rectangular band +/-10 K, standard u_T=10/sqrt(3) K. The uncertainty field is relative to ABSOLUTE temperature 293.15 K, not to 20 degC. Transferability: deliberate model convention for this plant, not measured/validated; no claimed seasonal coverage.
stor.T_assumed_C.effect: defined model temperature for static main runs, not a measured state. Rectangular-band uncertainty is used only with analyze_temperature_uncertainty=True: fixed-Z first-order u_T/T, separate from Route 2's existing 3 K allowance. Common-offset correlation is an optional-analysis model choice; mixed sources make only that analysis incomplete. Actual Z(T) local mass sensitivity at 300 bar absolute / 20 degC is -0.286176%/K; fixed-Z context -0.341122%/K. Sensitivities are references, not model inputs.

pv_inverter.title: F8 SolisCloud portal chart cadence (docs/03; D32)
pv_inverter.text:
- **Value and unit:** `300 s` minimum observed interval; nominal grid derived under D32(a), not a registry parameter.
- **Source:** SolisCloud portal, `data/raw/Daily+Power+Station+Chart_29-10-2026.xls`, owner-provided export; SHA-256 `754740b3eb2e8f119bfa1b200fa2f0ae2c66b872c28bdc3166d416281d742621`.
- **Location:** Sheet `Daily Power Station Chart_29-10`; metadata rows 1, 3-4; column headings row 29; data rows 30-191. The filename date is 29-10-2026; the sheet title identifies the chart date as 28/10/2026.
- **Verbatim quote:** `Plant_28/10/2026Chart`; `Plant:F8_Fachada Leste`; `Installed Capacity:12.780kWp`; headers `Number`, `Time`, `Working State`, `PV(W)`; time cells include `05:45:00`, `05:50:00`, `05:55:00`, `19:05:00`, and `19:25:00`. The 162 readings yield 160 intervals of 300 s and one interval of 1200 s.
- **Source conditions:** F8 station portal daily chart for 28-10-2026; station total, with no per-inverter serial-number breakdown.
- **Transferability:** Supports the 300-s nominal grid for the F8 portal daily chart and the docs/03 SolisCloud daily-PV source under D32. It does not assert that every Solis interface emits timestamps exactly on that grid; the `inverterDay` API history is a separate jitter observation. The quoted capacity figure is verbatim file content for provenance; the owner selected 12.74 kWp (28 x 455 Wp) for the F8 array despite the station-list value 12.78 kWp (decisions/2026-11-15-pv-module-count.md).
- **Registry status and uncertainty:** N/A (analysis property, not a registry value); basis `grid-derived` under D32(a). The official SolisCloud API documentation was checked 2026-10-29: no endpoint-specific resolution statement for `inverterDay`; its `dataTimestamp` field is described as `Update time`. The general statement `Device data upload frequency: 5 minutes` is not endpoint-specific and is not used as the basis. See SolisCloud Developer Platform, [Data Access API (User Auth)](https://developer.soliscloud.com/guide/data-access-user.html).
- **Used by:** docs/03 nominal-sampling table.
- **Reviewer/date:** owner approved 2026-10-29.

h2_compressor.title: HULC source conditions and open questions
h2_compressor.text:
Evidence: sources/Compressor_System_Specs_Master_v2.xlsx, Master and Sources
sheets; individual parameters identify the relevant rows and sources.
Workbook SHA-256: 07b082dbacf00dc6b9332d3d7ce0f262041003bdf3913cce0dacedad07a33145.
The prior workbook SHA-256 was c5585d5f4e6b73458c524106cdbc5b8002b67d57c1139220a9a704d30f1f1218.
The workbook is evidence, not the runtime parameter source. Manufacturer data
for DLE base devices are not verified for the installed -H2 variants. The
pressure reference is assumed gauge where marked; uncertainty 0.0 does not
establish zero uncertainty.

Agent checked 2026-11-16: workbook Master rows 86-91 and 97-102 against
the corresponding pressure ratios, inlet/outlet pressures, displacement,
cycle rate and compression ratios in the DLE 15 Apr-24 and DLE 30 Oct-25
base-type datasheets, page 1; row 108 against their drive-pressure ranges.
DLE 15: https://www.maximator.de/assets/mime/415f72351d5181b5354062839e0314ba/DB-01.02.02.02-Booster-DLE-15.pdf
DLE 30: https://maximatorus.com/uploads/Datasheets/DB-01.02.02.26-Booster-DLE-30-USA.pdf
The DLE 15 copy is not the workbook's S8 copy; the DLE 30 filename differs
from its internal identifier, as noted under hulc.pl_max_barg. Connections,
H2-option ratios and applicability to installed -H2 devices were not checked
by this comparison. H2 Core TDS p.2 module pressure classes, inlet limits and
maximum flow in rows 75, 77 and 78 were also checked; owner review is pending.

P-1: Confirm air-consumption chart conditions, volume basis, module
configuration, purge/control air and applicability to installed -H2 units.
P-2: Confirm whether the DLE table pressures are gauge or absolute.
P-3: Confirm applicable pressure limits for installed parts 3630.3019 and
3630.2374. Maximator Operating, maintenance and repair instructions for DLE 15
and DLE 30, section 4, p.5:
https://highpressuretech.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/DLE15-DLE30.pdf
lists maximum inlet and operating pressures of 150 and 300 bar respectively;
the base-type datasheets above list 300 and 600 bar respectively. Which
limits apply to the installed parts is UNVERIFIED.
